name: accordo
description: Build a CRM as code you own. Eleven skills that take a coding agent from a business objective to checked-in modules, deterministic workflows, policy-gated approvals, audit and trace — plus the project MCP server, whose code-generating tools are dry-run until you pass --apply.

blockedOn: The public name is undecided (docs/strategy/BRAND_REQUIREMENTS.md). `name` here is public-facing and namespaces every skill as `<name>:<skill>`, so publishing before the rename would break every installed user on the day it changes.
Publishing a marketplace and submitting to the community marketplace are human decisions (docs/strategy/MASTER_PLAN.md §10.4).
metadata.productionPosture: The framework has no authentication, tenancy or RBAC; the MCP server is stdio and local, and runs with the authority of the process that starts it.
